description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding flow logic in the AI OpenClaw Android application. It tests the conditions under which onboarding can be finished based on connection statuses.

classes.name: OnboardingFlowLogicTest
classes.description: Test class for onboarding flow logic, verifying whether onboarding can be completed based on different connectivity scenarios.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyOperatorIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot be finished when only the operator is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot be finished when no connections are active.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyNodeIsConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding cannot be finished when only the node is connected.

methods.name: allowsFinishOnlyWhenOperatorAndNodeAreConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding can only be finished when both operator and node are connected.
